themesScene captures theme-<rawValue> for every AppTheme with a 500ms settle each, then restores the original theme and waits 800ms
diffScene clears diff focus and anchor, sets isDiffVisible true, waits 1_200ms, takes the still, then hides the diff and waits 600ms
queueScene enqueues three follow-ups 800ms apart, waits 1_200ms, shoots, then removes every queued prompt
paletteScene sets model.isCommandPalettePresented = true, waits 800ms, shoots, dismisses, waits 500ms

questionScene over a gradient (film: false) resolves the question and returns before the approval half, so no approval is left behind; in the website run it continues to a t-edit2 FileEdit (additions 18, deletions 3) and the git push approval, waits 2_400ms and shoots "approval"

sliderScene film: 900ms, start film, 900ms, effort -> "xhigh" (snappy 0.2), 800ms, effort -> "max", 2_000ms, still "slider", fastMode true, 2_200ms, fastMode false + effort "medium", 1_000ms, effort "high", 1_100ms, stop film, close popover, 500ms
Every effort change is wrapped in withAnimation(.snappy(duration: 0.2))
slashScene seeds the command registry itself because the run never launches CLIs, sets draft.text = "/", waits 900ms, shoots, then clears the draft
tourRect(around:) widens or heightens symmetrically around the window's centre to exactly 1.6 aspect, rounding x, y, width and height
tourCaptureRect(including: popover) unions the window frame with the popover panel's window frame when the popover is shown
popoverFocus returns the union of the popover panel and the chip's screen rect, or the panel alone when no anchor, or nil when not shown

ensureActive loops up to 24 times at 250ms (6 seconds max) waiting for NSApp.isActive && window.isKeyWindow, logs "could not become the active app" on failure, and sleeps an extra 450ms when it had to activate; when the window is hidden it only waits for NSApp.isActive
holdPopover polls every 200ms and re-shows a popover that closed on its own, logging "popover closed on its own; showing it again"

presentPopover tries four anchors in order: an explicitly given frame, the thread's recorded chip frame, the live modelChipAnchor view, then the fallback rect at the composer's right end; each logs a distinct line ("popover WxH at the given frame ...", "... at the chip's frame ...", "... at the chip's rect ...", "popover WxH without a chip anchor")
NSPopover.behavior is .applicationDefined so it never closes on its own from a click
Sidecar geometry: "window" is [window.minX - rect.minX, rect.maxY - window.maxY, window.width, window.height], i.e. converted to a top-left origin inside the still; "focus" is written the same way

SCStreamConfiguration: sourceRect flipped with displayHeight - rect.maxY, width/height = Int(points * backingScaleFactor) & ~1 (forced even for the encoders), scalesToFit false, showsCursor false, captureResolution .best

FilmRecorder settings: HEVC, AVVideoAverageBitRateKey 80_000_000, AVVideoExpectedSourceFrameRateKey 60, AVVideoMaxKeyFrameIntervalKey 60, AVVideoAllowFrameReorderingKey false, pixel format kCVPixelFormatType_32BGRA, CMTime timescale 6_000, frames with time <= last are dropped
Film loop targets 1.0/60 s per frame and resets its schedule when it falls behind
Comment documents the isolation contract: own storage folder, own defaults suite, never reads the Keychain, posts no notifications, quits when the last file is written
The `started` flag in FilmRecorder is set true in init and never read again (dead state, still shipped)
unresolved_questions: CaptureRun (Core) holds outputDirectory, isTourRun, isEnabled, storageRoot, defaults and suiteName; the actual command-line parsing of --website-captures / --tour-captures is not in this file

WeakView, NSPopover.setFixedContent(_:size:) and WindowManager.shared.makeCaptureWindow(size:) are referenced but defined elsewhere, so the capture window's style mask and chrome cannot be pinned from here
hydraPanelFrames is declared and documented ("so the tour's Hydra page can zoom on the team's panel") but nothing in this bundle reads it; the reader is presumably elsewhere or it is currently unused

ID.diffPopover, ID.archive, ID.footer, ID.rail, ID.liveActivity and ID.widgets get library rows but no thread document, so their timelines are empty by design; whether any scene selects them is not shown here
scripts/website_captures.py consumes the stills, sidecars and .mov masters but is not in this bundle, so the exact cut/encode contract is unverified
AppTheme.allCases order and rawValues are not visible here, so the theme-<rawValue>.png filename set cannot be enumerated
